summary: A scrambler ascending the north side of the Third Flatiron on Monday morning became stuck in precarious, technical terrain and began yelling for help. A bystander located the stuck party and called 911. Rocky Mountain Rescue Group sent roped climbing teams from both above and below; once secured, the uninjured scrambler was lowered to the trail and hiked out to the trailhead.
location: North side of the Third Flatiron, Boulder
notes: Resolves the standing 2016-09-19 dating lead (run 506). Date from RMRG's own dated report ('Monday, September 19'; 2016-09-19 was Monday).
